<h2 class="wp-block-heading">What is Koala Go?</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.teachwithkoala.com/affiliate/5YSPW5" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Koala Go</a> is an exciting new online teaching platform which offers <strong>full interactivity on iPads</strong> – perfect for online ESL teachers!</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">It is designed specifically with virtual teaching in mind, and incorporates useful tools such as a great online whiteboard, fun Minecraft-style virtual learning world, screen-sharing and a co-browser (which allows both you and your students to interact directly with interactive slides such as the <a href="/curriculum">Abridge Academy resources</a> and play online games / activities). </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For this reason, it is our <strong>#1 recommended platform for teaching online</strong>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Right now, Koala Go are offering <a href="https://www.teachwithkoala.com/affiliate/5YSPW5" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">one month of Koala out for free</a>, then an incredible 20% off future paid subscriptions (or you can continue with just their free plan).</p>



<div class="responsive-google-slides"><iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/AGIIU0596ZM?si=bL-eQVCL_Ofjb9Ka&start=361" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen=""></iframe></div>



<div class="wp-block-uagb-container uagb-block-a7a1c795 alignfull uagb-is-root-container"><div class="uagb-container-inner-blocks-wrap">

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Advantages</h2>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Students can directly interact with Abridge Academy slides from any device, including iPads.</li>



<li>Great whiteboard tools and screen-sharing.</li>



<li>Built-in rewards system.</li>



<li>Excellent Minecraft-style “playground” immersive virtual learning world.</li>



<li>Download pre-made classroom templates from the Koala Go marketplace, or sell your own there for extra income! </li>



<li>Create “playground stories” learning adventures for student homework / to sell separately.</li>



<li>Invoice your students through Koala Go (accepts WeChat pay or card).</li>



<li>No software downloads needed – all in the web browser. </li>



<li>Excellent value for money.</li>
</ul>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-uagb-container uagb-block-a6b71f9b">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Disadvantages</h2>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>No out-of-class features or booking system.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Premium account features</h2>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Unlimited co-browser use.</li>



<li>Upload files (PDF worksheets, PPT slides, etc) to the whiteboard.</li>



<li>Unlimited whiteboards.</li>



<li>Student chat with translation.</li>



<li>Add images and audio to playground.</li>



<li>Bonus gems to spend on playground items.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This guide will answer some common questions for teachers using Koala Go and share helpful tips specific for using the Abridge Academy resources with Koala Go. </p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Parents guide (Chinese)</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Link for parents: <a rel="noopener" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A6ldHL-6ROY" target="_blank">YouTube</a> / <a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1UP411X7HC/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Bilibili</a></p>



<div class="responsive-google-slides"><iframe src="//player.bilibili.com/player.html?aid=313810203&bvid=BV1UP411X7HC&cid=1134054428&p=1" scrolling="no" border="0" frameborder="no" framespacing="0" allowfullscreen="true"> </iframe></div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Written guides for other languages are available on the Teach with Koala website.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Launching Koala Go and adding students</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">To get started, first visit the <a href="https://www.teachwithkoala.com/affiliate/5YSPW5" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener">Koala Go website</a>, sign up, then click “open Koala Go in browser”. This will load your activities, which are classrooms you can customise and prepare in advance for your students. Be sure to pre-load your Abridge Academy slides in the Koala Go browser (see below) too!</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Once you are ready for your class, you can invite students to join using the “invite” button at the top left corner within the Koala Go classroom. Simply copy the code and send it to your student via your preferred communication platform. They will first be placed into a “waiting room” from where you can authorise them to join the class.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1024" height="703" src="https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go-1024x703.png" alt="How to invite a student to Koala Go classroom" class="wp-image-16242" srcset="https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go-1024x703.png 1024w, https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go-300x206.png 300w, https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go-768x527.png 768w, https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go-1536x1054.png 1536w, https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go-624x428.png 624w, https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go-600x412.png 600w, https://abridgeacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/How-to-invite-student-to-koala-go.png 1780w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px"></figure>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Your code always stays the same, for all your students, so you can easily send it in advance of the class if you wish or add it to your booking system.</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Interactivity: Koala Go co-browsing/ web apps tool</h2>

			<span class="uagb-question"><strong>How is co-browsing different to screen sharing?</strong></span></div><div class="uagb-faq-content"><p>When you screenshare with software like Zoom, it is one-sided. Students can only annotate on top of the static shared screen. With co-browsing, both you and your student are directly interacting with the slides simultaneously. You can <strong>both </strong>click, drag-and-drop, type in text boxes, draw with the Abridge Academy slides drawing tool, etc. This is so much more engaging for students, and really makes the most of all the interactivity built into the Abridge Academy slides.</p></div></div></div>

The only reasoning I can see for such a statement is that KoalaGo is partnered Abridge and Katie (who I like, despite the inflated accolades afforded to the sloppy KoalaGo webapp. I’m sure I’ll get a “I’ve never had issues with it!” reply)</p>
<p>If you are teaching students outside of China, use Zoom, maybe with FunClass, but Zoom already has remote control so students can interact with your browser. If you are teaching Chinese students, try get a Chinese number (or ask a parent of a student to help) and register for Tencent Meeting instead of VooV (Tencnet Meeting has shared control options missing from VooV) – alternatively, ClassIn supports browser interaction if the student is learning from a computer and not an iPad or other tablet computer.</p>
<p>The whole experience so far has been stressful, has cost me money in lost classes, and has undermined my professionality.</p>
